name: queriocity
//test: Tests run with --no-env-file so local matches CI, which has no .env. Bun auto-loads .env otherwise, and a test that silently reads the developer's real config (EMBED_DIMENSIONS was the second case) passes here and fails there. What tests do need is set by lib/test-support/test-env.ts.
//engines: Bun runs everything here; Node is never required. Tools whose bin has a `#!/usr/bin/env node` shebang are invoked as `bun --bun <tool>` so they use Bun's runtime rather than whichever `node` is on PATH. Both current cases need Node >=20.19 (Vite 8, ESLint 10) and Ubuntu LTS still ships 18. The Docker image (oven/bun) has no real Node at all, only a shim, so without this local and container builds ran on different runtimes.

scripts.start: bun run src/server/index.ts & bun --bun vite dev --config vite.config.ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
